stories.story: As a person sharing or searching for a focx.ai link, I want the marketing root page to declare a meta description, so that link unfurls and search-engine snippets describe the product instead of showing nothing or falling back to arbitrary page text.
acceptanceCriteria: apps/site/index.html's <head> contains exactly one <meta name="description" content="..."> tag.
The tag's content attribute is exactly the existing subheading copy: 'Ticket in, reviewed pull request out — every stage built by bots, merged only by a human.'
The visible rendered page (hero, eyebrow, wordmark, subheading, CTA button) is unchanged — no new or modified visual elements.
node tools/contracts/validate.mjs passes for every artifact this run writes.

outOfScope: Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image) or Twitter Card meta tags.
Any change to the visible hero copy, layout, styling, or CTA.
Meta description tags on any page other than apps/site/index.html.
New design-system components or tokens of any kind.
